rule: change.to_create admits an accepted cell, refuses a refused cell with its recorded native refusal (TechnologyVersionRefused) and refuses every other CPU/type/version pair (TechnologyVersionUnprofiled) unless the payload sets unprofiledAcknowledged. Accepted means V21 created exactly that type and version at the PLC root of that CPU type identifier (order number and firmware); it does not qualify compile, connections, parameters or behavior. Cells come from native runs only: scripts/probe_technology_versions.py writes them, scripts/technology_version_profiles.py merges a curated run.
